amendment_A1.bound: a single amendment: if the pilot is still STOP under A1, T001 ends STOP
amendment_A1.change: the three seeded random-play scenarios become seeded novelty-driven explore scenarios with the same input policy, seeds, start window and frame budget: every 300 frames after the start window the emulator state is archived when new code was reached (new read-tap reader PCs or new per-frame sampled PCs) or the archive is empty; otherwise the next segment resumes from a seeded choice among the 8 most recent archived states. Generic (no title knowledge). One soundness tightening required by state loads: VDP DMA reconstruction treats registers as unknown at power-on and after every state load, and records a DMA only when register 1 and 0x13-0x17 were written since; and a reconstructed DMA extent is kept only where the same run's read tap saw those bytes read (both only drop DMA evidence, never add it). G1 gains an explore scenario and the fixture repeats its DMA every VBlank. Gates, thresholds and budgets are unchanged
amendment_A1.disclosure: explore mechanics were checked on the synthetic fixture only; no Chuck Rock run of A1 preceded this freeze
amendment_A1.replaced_result: Chuck Rock pilot under revision 4: G1-G4 hold (G4 rate 0.0007, all replicas identical); positive cells 266/8192 (3.25%), negative 344, mixed 24, 8.81 CPU-hours; self-assessed STOP (positives < 5%). Marginal new ROM PCs per scenario in plan order: attract 1537, play-s1 3839, play-s2 4, play-s3 220 (the random policy saturates)

amendments: a rule change after the freeze requires a recorded amendment (ADR), a re-freeze and a G1 rerun; results of the replaced plan are reported, never silently replaced
binding: T001 self-assesses; T002 (independent) owns the binding class
cell_labels: unchanged segarecomp_ml_v3.cell_labels: any I -> positive, all D -> negative, otherwise masked

classes.PARTIAL: G1-G5 hold, positive cells >= 5% of cells, but U1, U2, U3 or C1 fails (usable with documented limitation)
classes.PROCEED: G1-G5 hold and U1, U2, U3 and C1 hold
classes.STOP: any of G1-G5 fails, or positive cells < 5% of cells

cost.C1_definition: sum of single-CPU container wall time (traces, Ghidra -max-cpu 1) plus label wall time

disclosure: the DR tier and the 480 s play length were chosen after a bounded 60 s Chuck Rock preflight (aggregate counts only: low DMA-sourced data, read-tap throughput); no rule was tuned on labels

D: HW_HEADER: 0x000-0x1FF vector table and cartridge header

DMA: observed 68K-bus VDP DMA sources inside the image (control-port reconstruction; registers unknown at power-on and after a state load until rewritten; kept only where the same run's read tap saw the bytes read)

DR: observed data reads (program-space read tap, current-PC attribution) by an accepted executed reader or RAM code that never reads code bytes (accepted code or any executed PC's bytes) outside its own fetch window, excluding the 4-byte prefetch shadow after executed code; Z80/VDP bus reads are 68000 data; DR is disabled for the image when any scenario executes code from work RAM
no data byte overlaps an executed PC's bytes (accepted span, or [pc, pc+10) when rejected); HW/DMA extents touching code or such bytes are masked whole
Ghidra veto: an ADR-0025 code-entry candidate inside data unlabels the next 10 bytes
I/c: E executed: MAME 0.276 trace of :maincpu, PC inside the image, m68k-disasm (walk decode at that PC, else traced) and the CPU-owned decoder agree on the length; odd PCs, disagreements and overlapping executed spans are masked

R static reach: direct Bcc/BRA/BSR/DBcc/JMP/JSR(abs.w|abs.l|d16(PC)) targets and fall-through of non-call/trap, non-terminating instructions (calls/traps only when the return site was executed), from accepted code, with m68k-disasm walk + CPU-owned decoder length agreement and no overlap; never over or starting at a non-accepted executed PC; a candidate touching observed data is rejected at search time (successors unexplored); its non-observed bytes become U
evidence_tiers.U: everything else; unknown is never a negative
excluded: Ghidra as a label source (veto/disagreement only)
sega2asm (not selected for the pilot: no gap it fills)

gates.G1_synthetic_soundness: `g1`: 0 wrong I, c or D bytes on the committed synthetic cartridge vs its GNU as listing truth, for both the attract scenario (data reads active) and the play scenario (RAM execution disables data reads)
gates.G2_determinism: both replicas of every scenario have identical PC, DMA and read digests (computed; a failure is reported, never dropped)
gates.G3_mapping: MAME ROM view equals the image (0 mismatched words) and no executed cartridge-space PC beyond the image
gates.G4_decoder_consistency: sum of E_* rejections / distinct executed cartridge-space PCs <= 0.02 (rejected bytes are masked from data)
gates.G5_reproduction: an independent validator (T002) re-runs label from the retained scenario evidence and obtains the same classes digest

report_metrics: qualified starts by tier (E/R) and continuation bytes
tool disagreement rates (E decode, Ghidra-in-data, DMA vs read-tap agreement)
per-scenario coverage and marginal new PCs in plan order (saturation)
wall and CPU cost per stage
status: amendment A1 after the revision-4 pilot (explore scenarios plus the DMA tightening their state loads require); revision 4 was frozen before the first full analysis
